scenarios.name: Toggle a panel from the right-docked ribbon selector

scenario_steps.name: the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the right with Modify visible
the user clicks the direct panel selector at the bottom of the ribbon
the panel checklist opens with Modify checked
the user clicks Modify in the checklist
Modify is unchecked and its panel is absent from the ribbon
the user clicks Modify in the checklist again
Modify is checked and its panel is visible on the right-docked ribbon
the user clicks the direct panel selector again
the checklist closes and the ribbon remains docked on the right
